mission.headTitle: To Move Apapa Forward With Better Governance & Development
mission.subTitle: Make we support long-lasting development, run government work well, and make life better for everybody wey dey Apapa through better public services, improved infrastructure, and inclusive economic growth — using Apapa position as Nigeria main port city.

vision.subTitle: To become example of strong maritime and urban local government — clean, well-connected, rich, and strong — where people dey do well and business dey move smoothly.

coreValues.desc1: We dey open and clear in everything we do, and we dey answer to the people wey we serve.
coreValues.desc2: We dey always aim for high standard for governance, service delivery, and infrastructure.
coreValues.desc3: We dey do our work with honesty and strong moral principles at all times.
coreValues.desc4: We dey welcome everybody and make sure say nobody dey left behind.
coreValues.desc5: We dey use smart and modern ideas to solve local problems in a better way.
coreValues.desc6: We dey strong to face challenges and adjust to changes so progress no go stop.

purpose.subTitle: To govern Apapa well and fairly — using the port economy, rich history, and human resources of Apapa to bring real development, protect our culture, and create opportunities for today and future generations.

commitment.subTitle: Apapa Local Government dey committed to improve infrastructure like roads, drainage, and public spaces to support residents and port activities; support economic empowerment through business-friendly policies and help for local businesses; improve social welfare by increasing access to healthcare, education, housing, and other important services; protect the environment by solving flooding, waste, and pollution issues through active, community-based solutions; and encourage civic participation by listening to citizens, involving them in governance, and keeping communication open and transparent.

history1.badge: The Rich Heritage and Legacy of Apapa
history1.headTitle: One Historic Maritime Gateway for Nigeria
history1.subTitle: Apapa Local Government Area (LGA) na one of the most important places for history and economy for Lagos State, Nigeria. From when e just be small fishing village, Apapa don grow become Nigeria main maritime and commercial center. Apapa don play big role for how Lagos take grow reach global city level.

history2.subTitle: Long before city development start, Apapa na calm settlement wey fishermen and traders dey live. Dem depend on the water side location to survive and do business. Because e close to Atlantic Ocean and Lagos Lagoon, Apapa naturally turn trade center even before colonial time, and e attract traders and settlers.

evolutionOfApapa.subTitle: During British colonial time, dem quickly see Apapa potential. Colonial government build ports, warehouses, and railway lines to support shipping and trade. Apapa grow fast become important international shipping hub and later turn the commercial heartbeat of Lagos.

history3.subTitle: Early 20th century mark big turning point when dem build Apapa Port, wey lay foundation for wetin become Nigeria most important maritime zone. Later, Tin Can Island Port join am, make Apapa house two of Nigeria busiest seaports. Dem handle about 75% of the country total import and export. Today, these ports na lifeline for Nigeria economy, dey process goods worth billions of naira every year. For just first quarter of 2023, Apapa Customs Command generate over ₦212 billion revenue, show how financially important the area be.

history4.subTitle: For 1977, Lagos State Government officially create Apapa as Local Government Area to bring governance closer to the people and reduce central control. Later on, places like Apapa Iganmu comot from am to form other local development councils.

history5.subTitle: Apapa dey Lagos State, one of Africa biggest economies with GDP of about $259.75 billion (PPP) for 2023. Apapa dey the center of this economic power. E contribution to trade, logistics, and revenue generation no get mate, and the history still dey inspire progress, innovation, and community development.

landmarkAndInfluence.subTitle: Apapa today na busy place with residential, commercial, and industrial activities. E get important national and regional landmarks like:

coreValues.description1: NPA Headquarters for Apapa na the main office wey dey control Nigeria port operations, dey oversee activities for major seaports and make sure maritime trade dey run smoothly.
coreValues.description2: One of Nigeria busiest and most strategic seaports, Tin Can Island Port dey handle plenty container cargo and play key role for Nigeria import and export economy.
coreValues.description3: Eleganza Plaza na popular commercial complex wey get shops, offices, and wholesale outlets, make am busy trade and business center for the heart of Apapa.
coreValues.description4: Family-friendly relaxation spot, Apapa Amusement Park get rides, games, and open spaces, give residents and visitors place to relax and enjoy.

history6.badge: A Thriving Cultural Mosaic at the Heart of Nigeria’s Port City
history6.subTitle: Apapa no be just port city; na diverse community full of strength and rich culture. People from different ethnic backgrounds dey live and work together, make Apapa true example of Nigeria unity in diversity.

history7.badge: Overcoming Challenges to Restore Apapa’s Economic Vitality
history7.subTitle: Even with all e importance, Apapa dey face modern challenges like bad infrastructure, flooding, and serious traffic jam—especially from trucks wey dey go port. These problems no be only local wahala; dem affect Nigeria economy, as traffic gridlock alone dey cost the country up to ₦18 trillion every year. But government and private sector dey work together to renew the area, improve infrastructure, and bring back Apapa glory as Nigeria economic engine.

executiveChairman.bannerTitle: Executive Chairman of the Local Government
executiveChairman.overview: The Executive Chairman na the main oga for the local government. E dey in charge of how policies dey implemented and how daily administration dey run. This role dey very important for local governance because the chairman dey manage executive duties and make sure say all local government activities follow the policies wey the elected council set.
executiveChairman.name: Hon. Idowu Adejumoke Senbanjo
executiveChairman.introduction: Hon. Idowu Adejumoke Senbanjo, the Executive Chairman of Apapa Local Government Council, get plenty experience from both public and private sectors. She get Bachelor of Arts (Hons) for Languages and Linguistics from University of Jos and Master of Arts for International Law and Diplomacy from University of Lagos. For her professional career, she don work as Team Head of Public Sector – South-West Region, Team Leader for Retail Banking, and Head of Corporate Affairs for Metropolitan Bank. For public service, she serve as Senior Special Assistant to Lagos State Governor on Housing and Senior Special Assistant on Poverty Eradication. As committed member of All Progressives Congress (APC), Hon. Senbanjo don contribute well well to the political and economic development of Apapa, making her a transformational leader for the community.

vision&Mission.overview: Hon. Senbanjo get strong commitment to transform Apapa to a modern port city wey go provide effective grassroots governance and development. Her administration dey focus on:

visionMissionItems.description1: Improve roads, drainage systems, and public facilities to make life better for residents.
visionMissionItems.description2: Support business growth and economic activities to create opportunities for residents.

visionMissionItems.description4: Promote environmental initiatives to make Apapa cleaner and healthier.

manifesto.overview: Her manifesto stand on four major focus areas which include security – traffic and transport, health, environment – infrastructure, education – skill acquisition and technology (S.H.E.E).

01.title: Security
01.content: Security dey very important for business success, especially as Apapa get strategic role for Lagos State economy. We dey strengthen our security system to ensure safety for businesses, visitors, and residents. Continuous improvement and adaptation dey key, with support from technical assistance and community partnerships.

02.content: Good health no get price. Na this belief dey guide our people-focused health and wellness programmes. Over the past four years, we don get fully equipped ambulance for emergencies and strengthen primary healthcare services.

04.content: We believe say knowledge na power and skills na tools for transformation. We dey invest in education, skill acquisition, and information technology to prepare the next generation.
